issue.operator_selection: DT analysis previously preferred forced_active_diagnostic at every checkpoint and therefore discarded registered evidence inside the real active-age interval.
issue.operator_semantics: At the pre-support e20 state the registered path is zero or warmup-limited; forced-active is retained to measure the parent DT mechanism rather than schedule identity.
issue.temporal_grouping: Rollout-speed history was split when the preferred DT record changed from registered to forced-active, hiding cross-stage precursor evidence.

identity_policy.audit_branch_role: Generate immutable counterfactual and variance rows only.
identity_policy.main_branch_role: Recompute the final causal matrix from immutable rows with the corrected analysis identity.
